Title: Perfect flat white
Review: Smooth espresso with beautifully steamed milk. The barista knows what they are doing and the beans are roasted locally.

Title: Wonderful brunch
Review: The avocado toast with poached eggs and chili oil was fresh and generous. Sourdough was toasted just right.

Title: Oat and almond milk
Review: Several plant milks at no extra charge and a vegan breakfast burrito that was filling. Good for dairy free diners.

Title: Busy weekends
Review: Saturday brunch means a 40 minute queue and every table is taken. Come on a weekday for a calmer visit.

Title: Wifi and outlets
Review: Reliable wifi and plenty of outlets. I worked here for four hours and no one rushed me. Great remote work spot.

Title: Dry pastries
Review: The croissant was stale and the blueberry muffin was dry. Coffee is much better than the baked goods.

Title: Harbor view
Review: The patio overlooks the water and is dog friendly. Staff even brought a water bowl for our dog.

Title: Pricey
Review: A latte and a pastry came to 11 dollars. Quality is good but the prices are on the high side.

Title: Friendly baristas
Review: They remembered my name and my usual order by the third visit. Warm, genuinely welcoming staff.

Title: Slow service
Review: Waited 25 minutes for two sandwiches while the cafe was only half full. The order was also missing the side salad.

Title: Gluten free bread
Review: They offer gluten free bread and keep a separate toaster. Staff were careful when I mentioned celiac disease.

Title: Great soup of the day
Review: The roasted tomato soup with grilled cheese was comforting on a rainy day. Fair portion for the price.

Title: Kid friendly
Review: A small kids corner with books and a menu with pancakes and fruit cups. The staff were relaxed about noise.

Title: Cold sandwich
Review: My panini was lukewarm in the middle and the cheese had not melted. It seemed rushed.

Title: Excellent cold brew
Review: Smooth, low acid cold brew served over big ice cubes that do not water it down. A summer favorite.

Title: Clean restrooms
Review: Bright, modern interior and the restrooms were spotless. Plenty of natural light.

Title: Loud espresso machine
Review: Great coffee but the grinder and machine are loud and sit right next to the counter seats. Not for phone calls.

Title: Cash not accepted
Review: They only take cards and mobile payments. A sign near the door would have helped.

Title: Lovely cheesecake
Review: Baked lemon cheesecake with a buttery crust. Light, tangy and worth saving room for.

Title: Early opening
Review: Opens at 6:30 AM, which is perfect for commuters. Coffee was ready quickly and a breakfast sandwich was hot.

Title: Wrong milk
Review: I asked for oat milk and got dairy. I only noticed after drinking, which is a problem for allergies.

Title: Live music night
Review: Friday evenings have acoustic live music on the patio. Cozy string lights and a short but good wine list.
